verdict.rationale: v0 is fundamentally a chat/natural-language interface where users describe UI, fixes, and app features in plain English and v0 generates code, fixes builds, and deploys — confirmed by docs and the SDK's chat-based API (message: 'Build me a personal website'). Community evidence corroborates real-world use building full apps via natural-language prompting. missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of complex multi-turn natural-language command sequences, and no detail on limits of NL command scope (e.g., non-UI infra commands).
